Class PlayerSetting<T>

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.player.PlayerSetting<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed
public final class PlayerSetting<T> extends Object implements net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed
A per-player value players change themselves (D37), with /machinesettings or the zMenu settings menu. Registered with RegistrationContext#playerSettings(); read with MachinePlayer.get(PlayerSetting), which applies the server owner's default and lock (players.setting-defaults, players.locked-settings in MachineEngine's config.yml).

The value is saved as text, so a setting's default may change between versions without a migration. Players see the name and description translated on their client (D23): the lang keys setting.<namespace>.<id> and setting.<namespace>.<id>.description of the addon's CraftEngine pack.

public static final PlayerSetting<Boolean> HUD = PlayerSetting.bool(Key.key("mymod", "hud"), true);
